purpose: Give the v4 baseline-conditioned margin actuator explicit compositional state semantics without falsely assuming that donorward effects add across sequential edits.

construction.state: immutable native baseline margin plus zero or one typed edit specification per independent example slot
construction.evaluation: always evaluate baseline plus the currently selected frozen effect; never sum donorward effects

predictions.pred_a_authority_and_complete_domain: Hashes match and the exhaustive domain contains ten Task14 edits, six bracket edits, three bracket self-pair identities, and explicit Task14 no-edit.
predictions.pred_b_identity_and_idempotence: No-edit is exact identity and applying the same typed edit twice gives the same state and margin as applying it once for every edit and multiple finite baselines.
predictions.pred_c_last_write_wins: For every valid ordered pair of same-slot edits, composition equals direct evaluation of the second edit from the immutable baseline.
predictions.pred_d_independent_commutativity: For every cross-slot Task14/bracket edit pair, either application order produces bit-identical typed state and margins.
predictions.pred_e_no_hidden_additivity_or_price: The implementation contains no effect-summing path, stores no new learned scalar, performs one lookup and one addition per edited slot, and rejects malformed or cross-typed edits.

terminal.screen: All five predictions pass. Release as an exact software/tensor composition contract around the empirically screened v4 effects.
terminal.null: Any failed algebra, domain, rejection, or price gate rejects composability until the interface is corrected without changing frozen effects.

closed_claims: empirical causal superposition of sequential internal interventions
